stages.headline: y = k/x (k ≠ 0) is inverse proportionality; it is defined for all x ≠ 0.

stages.headline: For k > 0 the graph lies in quadrants I and III and decreases on each branch; for k < 0, in II and IV.
stages.headlineEnglish: For k > 0 the graph lies in quadrants I and III and decreases on each branch; for k < 0, in II and IV.

stages.headline: The graph never meets the axes because x ≠ 0 and y ≠ 0; it is called a hyperbola.
